QuestInfo.name: Spiderglue
QuestInfo.1: Collect  #b50 #t04000097##k from #b#o2230103##k in Eos Tower and take them to #b#p2040005##k. #b#o2230103##k can be found at #b#m221022600##k.\r\n\r\n
QuestInfo.2: It's hard to say how he'll use the #t04000097# you brought, but that's not your problem!

0.0: I'm never going to get out of here, am I? What can I... \nOh, hello there. You're, uh, #b#h0##k, right?
0.1: I never forget a face! Especially one that can help me out. You can help me out, can't you?

yes.0: Now there's the answer I wanted to hear!\r\nLook, I'm in charge of repairs here at Eos Tower and I'm all out of #bglue#k. That just isn't going to work.
yes.1: I can't leave my other work just to get some glue. But YOU can. Bring me #b50 #t04000097#s#k so I can make my own.
yes.2: You can find #b#t04000097#s#k on #b#m221022600##k, below here.

1.0: Did you do it? Can I finally get back to work?

yes.0: One, two, three... Fifty!\r\nRepairs are back on schedule!

item.0: You can get a good supply of #b#t04000097#s#k from #b#o2230103#s#k bugs on #b#m221022600##k.\nPlease make sure to bring me not 48, 49, but #b50#k.
